propositions: A new commit_and_push_tickets_branch entrypoint must stage and commit dirty tracker changes under a write lock before delegating to push_tickets_branch for delivery.
The entrypoint must check for rebase/merge-recovery state before staging; strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked, default mode warns and returns without committing.
Supplied author name/email must be applied per-commit via git -c flags without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity is used when omitted.

The entrypoint must delegate to push_tickets_branch unconditionally after optional commit, even for clean/ahead trees; strict mode raises PushDeliveryError if push fails while commits remain local-only.

Lock, stage, and commit failures must raise dependency-defined PushDeliveryError with stable reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed) in strict mode; default mode logs warning and returns without push.

A private CLI adapter at python -m rebar._store.push must expose commit-and-push action with --tracker, --message, --strict, --author-name, --author-email flags while preserving the existing push action unchanged.
